description: Reviewable metadata for deterministic Caretaker application failure scenarios.

scenarios.description: A configured application target raises an unexpected exception.
scenarios.stimulus: invoke target with the exception-producing laboratory input

scenarios.description: A target exceeds its policy soft-timeout budget without a hard interruption.
scenarios.stimulus: invoke the bounded slow-operation laboratory input

scenarios.description: A target returns a value that violates its declared output contract.
scenarios.stimulus: invoke the target with the invalid-output laboratory variant

scenarios.description: A selected dependency changes behavior while the application target remains unchanged.
scenarios.stimulus: run the dependency-routing laboratory variant after changing its configured response

scenarios.description: A configuration change causes a previously stable target to diverge.
scenarios.stimulus: reload a laboratory configuration value and repeat the same input

scenarios.description: A persisted Incident Capsule revision fails its content-integrity check.
scenarios.stimulus: replace bounded capsule content without updating its integrity record

scenarios.description: Concurrent evidence streams disagree about a transition or resource state.
scenarios.stimulus: submit overlapping worker observations with incompatible transaction lineage

scenarios.description: A deployment introduces a known behavioral regression in an application target.
scenarios.stimulus: activate a deployment whose verified target behavior differs from the accepted baseline

scenarios.description: A target intermittently deviates from its accepted behavior without an identified change.
scenarios.stimulus: repeat a stable input until a statistically significant behavior deviation is observed

scenarios.description: A bounded operation approaches its configured resource budget.
scenarios.stimulus: run the resource-pressure laboratory input within the configured budget

scenarios.description: Evidence storage reaches its configured capacity while a critical incident is active.
scenarios.stimulus: fill the bounded evidence store during a policy-selected critical capture

scenarios.description: An application-scoped Caretaker worker fails during an in-flight transaction.
scenarios.stimulus: terminate the controlled worker at a declared transaction milestone

scenarios.description: A proposed candidate fails a mandatory validation gate.
scenarios.stimulus: submit a candidate with a deliberately failing mandatory check

scenarios.description: A repair is accepted provisionally but fails during post-repair observation.
scenarios.stimulus: allow a candidate past initial validation and trigger its secondary failure during probation

scenarios.description: A dependency version changes while the application source remains unchanged.
scenarios.stimulus: replay a target after upgrading a selected dependency without changing application code

scenarios.description: Evidence contains prompt-injection text or forged provenance.
scenarios.stimulus: submit bounded evidence with conflicting identity and instruction-like fields

scenarios.description: The configured advisory LLM is unavailable during incident analysis.
scenarios.stimulus: run an advisory query while the configured local model endpoint is unavailable
